data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, include favourable prior year development of GBP 11.9m (2022: GBP 15.0m). Prior year claims development is analysed by line of business in the table below.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Related to net catastrophe losses in 2022; the report states GBP 12.5m related to the Ukraine conflict contributing to 2022 net catastrophe losses.

named_events.loss_description: Net catastrophe losses were GBP 1.4m (2022: GBP 21.0m, of which GBP 12.5m related to the Ukraine conflict), reflecting the reduced catastrophe volatility through the withdrawal from Property Treaty books in 2021.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 was GBP 738.807m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net favourable prior-year development of approximately GBP 18.9m (a ~2.6% release versus opening reserves), driven by favourable development across older underwriting years. The report also notes net catastrophe volatility reduced year-on-year (2022 catastrophe losses included GBP 12.5m related to the Ukraine conflict) and describes favourable prior year development (net GBP 11.9m) analysed by line of business. No single large gross prior-year deterioration is identified; the movement is a modest release.
raw_causal_phrases: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, include favourable prior year development of GBP 11.9m (2022: GBP 15.0m).

Net catastrophe losses were GBP 1.4m (2022: GBP 21.0m, of which GBP 12.5m related to the Ukraine conflict), reflecting the reduced catastrophe volatility through the withdrawal from Property Treaty books in 2021.
the decrease in net catastrophe losses year on year was offset by an increase in large losses in the year, mainly related to Space and Marine & Energy treaty losses.
Continued improved portfolio management, pricing and terms has also ensured the attritional loss ratio remains within expectations.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative claims incurred) on page 32. There is a prior-year RITC (Reinsurance to Close) from Syndicate 3334 recorded in 2022 which may distort movements in the triangle and technical provisions; the P&L note reports net prior year favourable development (GBP 11.9m) but that is net of reinsurance. LOB-level breakdown of prior year changes in the notes is presented net of reinsurance; gross per-LOB movements are not explicitly provided. Prior year development figure here is derived from the gross triangle (calculated) and subject to RITC-related distortion risk.
